$comment: The race chapter: one race drawn kilometre by kilometre. splits are per-km times (m:ss) as recorded; they may be a few seconds off the official PR time (the clock is scaled to finish on it). Notes appear when the marker passes `at` (0..1).

notes.title: Km 1 · 3:57
notes.text: Straight onto 3:57 pace from the gun.

notes.title: Km 2 · 4:00
notes.text: Three seconds slower. The slowest kilometre of the race, and it was still four minutes flat.

notes.title: Km 3 · 3:57
notes.text: Back to 3:57. Halfway through, and the pace hasn't moved.

notes.title: Km 4 · 4:00
notes.text: 4:00 again. Every kilometre so far within three seconds of the others.

notes.title: Km 5 · 3:57
notes.text: Closed with another 3:57 to finish in 19:47.
